concept: Making sustainable choices in major life decisions (housing, transportation, career) without requiring perfection
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic major life decision (where to live, how to commute, what work to do) with a meaningful environmental dimension alongside other real constraints
exercise.reflection_prompt: How do you weigh environmental impact against the other real factors in a major decision like this?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies how they'd actually weigh the environmental factor without making it the only consideration or ignoring it entirely

assessment.success_marker: adult integrates the environmental factor realistically alongside other legitimate constraints
